verdict.rationale: Raygun's docs show custom tags as a filter dimension and prioritization by users affected, which implies events carry tags and user identity. Error payloads also include environment, browser, version and host alongside the stack trace. Breadcrumbs are never mentioned, and there are no SDK-level docs on attaching tags or user context per event. Missing for 10: breadcrumb support, SDK documentation for setting custom tags and user context on each event, independent or hands-on corroboration.
